We’re beyond excited to finally share something special with you—our very first book, "Strange Creatures"! It’s filled with all the amazing animal facts and beautiful original illustrations that you’ve come to love from us. Order today: http://bit.ly/animalogicbook

From deep-sea giants to massive prehistoric monsters that once ruled the skies and land, we are counting down the absolute largest creatures to ever exist on Earth. Some of these titans are still alive today, while others are newly discovered prehistoric beasts that challenge everything we thought we knew about evolution!
